basic_details.job_title: NRLM Taluk Program Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NRLM Karnataka is taking applications for one Taluk Program Manager (Level L4) post at Mulbagal taluk, Kolar district. The applicant needs a full-time two-year Post Graduate Degree or a PG Diploma and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience after qualification, and must be aged 18 to 45 years. Applications opened on 27 November 2026 and close on 12 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka
content_sections.text: The listing is published under the name NRLM Karnataka on the Karnataka recruitment portal. The post leads the Block team and works with the DMMU and SMMU on Mission activities, self-help group support and community institutions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Full time Post Graduate Degree (2 Years) / PG Diploma. Minimum 5 years post qualification relevant experience. Preference shall be given to candidates with minimum 1 year experience as Taluk Mission Manager or 2 years as Cluster Supervisor. Reading, writing (including typing) and speaking skills in Kannada and English. Knowledge of working with computers. The listing shows a minimum age of 18 years and a maximum of 45 years, and states the age limit as 45 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification on the portal for any discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Taluk Program Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: Undertake field visits proactively. Provide necessary technical and management support for implementation of all Mission activities, i.e. Cluster Coordinators and Area Coordinators, and conduct regular review meetings. Identify opportunities and implement activities under convergence model. Facilitate preparation of plans by community level institutions and its implementation. Coordinate with banks for bank linkage of SHGs with the support of the financial inclusion cell at DMMU and SMMU. Facilitate design, strategy and roll out of annual work plans, perspective plans under the Monitoring and Evaluation component for the block. Undertake regular monitoring through field visits. Identify the vulnerable stakeholders in the block with reference to Women, Differently abled, SC / STs and other under privileged sections. Report to DMMU and submit MPRs, QPRs and other relevant reports. Liaison with PRI institutions, line departments and other non government organizations. Take up any other task as allocated by competent authority at DMMU.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NRLM Karnataka Taluk Program Manager
content_sections.text: Open the job listing for Taluk Program Manager, Kolar, Mulbagal, on the portal. Sign in to submit the application; new users can create a free account. Submit the application before the closing date of 12 December 2026. The notice names no documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is at Level L4 and reports directly to the Executive Officer, TP. The post also reports to the State Mission Director / CEO-ZP / PD-DRDA / State Program Managers. The purpose of the post is to provide leadership to the Block team for strengthening the processes at the Block Level.
